stories.title: Trump, Xi and Putin Shake Hands as Leaders Gather in China
stories.summary: China’s leader, Xi Jinping, earlier hugged President Trump on the tarmac as he arrived for a regional summit in Shenzhen. They are expected to hold a trilateral meeting on Thursday with President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia.

stories.title: Crimean Bridge attacked again, Russia says
stories.summary: The head of Crimea said traffic was suspended after another attack on the link between Russia and the occupied territory.

stories.title: How the War in Iran Will Remake the Global Energy Order
stories.summary: The International Energy Agency, in its most comprehensive analysis of the war’s fallout, found the oil shock could accelerate adoption of alternative power sources.

stories.title: Florida Man Found Guilty in Plot to Kill Haiti’s President
stories.summary: Christian Emmanuel Sanon, 67, who was convicted in a Miami court, could now face life in prison over the killing of Jovenel Moïse.

stories.title: Uncontacted Awá of Brazil Emerge From Rainforest Seeking Food
stories.summary: A group of 20 people emerged from the forest and asked for food, an Indigenous peoples’ rights group said, raising fears that environmental degradation had left them with no choice but to reach out.

stories.title: AI giant Anthropic valued at $1.5 trillion ahead of stock market debut
stories.summary: The company behind the Claude chatbot will become one of the most valuable firms in the world.
